{{Quote|Move along. Security Regulation 44-13 designates security barricades as no-loitering zones.|Denal-zon|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Security Regulation 44-13''' was a regulation in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] that designated security barricades, such as the one erected by the CSF in the [[Old Galactic Market]], as no-loitering zones for civilians.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1stm}}
